references.text: Moses was commanded to make the tabernacle and all its equipment according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain.
The same command to make things according to the pattern shown on the mountain, here regarding the lampstand.
The tabernacle was to be erected according to the order shown to Moses on the mountain.
The lampstand was made according to the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.
Stephen refers to the fact that the tent of testimony was made according to the pattern Moses had seen.
Hebrews quotes that Moses was warned to make everything according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain.
Creates a theological arc from the wilderness tabernacle to the rebuilding of the temple: God's house must always be built according to his specific command and with materials he requires.
